warnings: No dimensions are given in the listing, so all sizes are assumptions. I assumed a 16 mm width and thickness from the goBILDA 8 mm grid. The 30 mm length comes from the face-on view, where the aspect ratio is about 1.85:1, so it may really be 32 mm. The 8 mm hole diameter is estimated from the visible bore and may be the thread opening rather than the minor diameter. Hole positions are read from the images; the hole near the rounded end is about 8 mm from that end. The listing text does not say whether the end-face hole is blind, so it is recorded as non-through. Thread details, chamfer size and corner radius are not modeled.
No dimensions are given in the listing, so all sizes come from the image analysis estimates and may be off.
The 6 mm fillet radius is a guess. It may actually be a full 8 mm radius, and it may apply to only one corner.
The 3 mm chamfer size and its location on the square end are estimated.
The 8 mm hole diameter may be the thread opening rather than the tap drill size. Threads and countersinks are not modeled.
The depth of the end-face hole is unknown, so a 16 mm blind hole is assumed.
The analysis axes are ambiguous, so the long axis was placed along Y following the bounds and hole positions.
